p045.lead: Jerusem, capital of Satania, and its fifty-seven architectural worlds: the System Sovereign, the four and twenty counselors, the Material Sons and Daughters, and the schools where ascending mortals first become universe citizens.

p045.foot.text: Presented by a Melchizedek of temporary assignment on Urantia

p045.s0.h: Introduction — The First Universe Capital Ascenders Meet
p045.s0.b0: Paper 43 dealt with the constellation; Paper 45 introduces the unit below it, the **local system**, and the administration of our own system, Satania. Its administrative center is a cluster of fifty-seven architectural spheres: Jerusem, its seven major satellites, and forty-nine subsatellites. Jerusem is almost one hundred times the size of Urantia, though its gravity is a trifle less.
p045.s0.b1: These fifty-seven worlds are independently lighted, heated, watered, and energized by the co-ordination of the Satania Power Center and the Master Physical Controllers, and are physically cared for by the native spornagia. They are specially created architectural worlds that do not depend on a sun as the evolutionary planets do.
p045.s0.b3: What brings this paper close to home is that the mansion worlds, where we awaken after death, are part of this very system administration. It is around Jerusem that we first learn universe citizenship, make up for missed experience, and learn to live together in society.
p045.s1.h: I. Transitional Culture Worlds — Seven Spheres Around Jerusem
p045.s1.b0: The seven major worlds swinging around Jerusem are known as the transitional culture spheres, and each has seven satellites. As you advance from one mansion world to the next, you become eligible to visit the corresponding transition world.

p045.s1.b2: Mansion world sojourners go to the finaliter world at least once a year to glimpse those who have completed the Paradise ascension. These finaliters have returned to the very worlds where we start, as a pledge that we too can finish the journey. The prison worlds around the Father’s world, by contrast, holding Lucifer and his associates who rejected salvation, serve as a solemn warning to all Nebadon.
p045.s2.h: II. The System Sovereign — Lanaforge, Who Held Firm Through Rebellion
p045.s2.b0: The chief executive of a local system is a primary Lanonandek Son, the System Sovereign. In Nebadon these sovereigns are entrusted with unusually wide powers of personal discretion, and in all its history they have shown disloyalty only three times, the Lucifer rebellion being the last and most widespread. Even so, no changes were made afterward in the technique of system administration.
p045.s2.b1: The present sovereign, Lanaforge, is a rebellion-tested ruler. During the second system rebellion in Nebadon, as first assistant to the fallen sovereign, he seized the reins of government so that comparatively few personalities were lost. He is the only primary Lanonandek in Nebadon who served Michael loyally in the very presence of the default of his superior. He often visits Urantia, and every ten days he holds a purely social and spiritual gathering on the sea of glass.
p045.s2.b2: The Sovereign presides over the system council of world rulers, made up of the Planetary Princes and the resident governors general of the isolated worlds. The old records describe the times when this council assembles at the system headquarters in these words.
p045.s3.h: III. The System Government — Seven Lanonandeks and the Executive Council
p045.s3.b0: A System Sovereign is normally supported by two or three assistants, but because of the emergency of the rebellion, Satania is run by an expanded administration of seven Lanonandeks. The system is the unit of administration, not adjudication, so there are only minor courts on Jerusem.

Satania’s representation on the supreme council of the universe has been suspended because of rebellion, but since Michael’s bestowal the system has resumed electing ten members to the Edentia legislature.
p045.s4.h: IV. The Four and Twenty Counselors — A Council from Urantia
p045.s4.b0: At the center of the seven angelic residential circles on Jerusem is the headquarters of the Urantia advisory council, the four and twenty counselors—the “⟦Q 45:4.1⟧four and twenty elders⟦/Q⟧” of John the Revelator. These seats were placed no more than nineteen hundred years ago, soon after Michael was elevated to the full sovereignty of Nebadon, and the counselors were recruited from the eight Urantia races.

p045.s4.b2: What stands out in this list is its diversity. Leaders of the red, blue, yellow, green, orange, and indigo peoples led their own toward higher worship under names such as “⟦Q 45:4.3⟧The Breath Giver⟦/Q⟧,” “⟦Q 45:4.5⟧The Great Spirit⟦/Q⟧,” “One Truth,” and “⟦Q 45:4.9⟧The One Source of Life.⟦/Q⟧” The names they used for God differed, yet their sincere steps were honored in the universe. That Adam and Eve, who failed and were rehabilitated, sit with them speaks of the hope of restoration.
p045.s4.b3: Machiventa Melchizedek has latterly been proclaimed vicegerent Planetary Prince of Urantia, with authority to act on behalf of Michael, who is in fact the Planetary Prince of the world where he made his final bestowal. Seats 17 through 24 are kept open for ascenders and teachers of ages to come. These empty seats are a sign that the history of Urantia is not yet finished.
p045.s5.h: V–VI. The Material Sons; Adamic Training of Ascenders
p045.s5.b0: At the heart of Jerusem stands the chief temple of the Material Sons. The Material Sons and Daughters are the highest type of sex-reproducing beings on the training spheres of the evolving universes, the last physical link in the chain of personality reaching from divinity to humanity. At the last registration there were 161,432,840 of them with citizenship on the system capitals of Nebadon. The Adamites of Jerusem govern themselves by universal suffrage and representative government and hope one day for virtually complete autonomy.
p045.s5.b2: The Material Sons and Daughters are the immediate sponsors and mentors of ascending mortals who have attained Jerusem citizenship. On the mansion worlds we can make up for nearly every experiential deprivation caused by heredity, environment, or early death, with one exception: deficiencies related to sex life. Their social, intellectual, emotional, and spiritual aspects are compensated by living closely with Adamic families.
p045.s5.b4: For this reason no mortal, midwayer, or seraphim may enter the Corps of the Finality without the experience of parenthood or its equivalent. Those who lack it gain it in the homes of the Material Sons on Jerusem or in the probation nursery on the finaliter world. There, children who died before acquiring spiritual status are reassembled; if either parent ascends, the child is repersonalized and given the opportunity to choose its own path.
p045.s5.b5: This passage is a deep comfort to parents who have lost a child early. It also shows how precious, in universe terms, the training of parenthood is. The labor of raising children is a school in which we learn how God deals with us.
p045.s6.h: VII. The Melchizedek Schools — Citizenship by Mota
p045.s6.b0: The mansion worlds are detention planets. Those who did not achieve fusion with the Adjuster during life in the flesh, and those whose soul attainment was cut short by hereditary handicap or unfavorable environment, learn there the essentials of the eternal career and acquire the traits they could not gain on earth. The Melchizedeks conduct upward of thirty educational centers on Jerusem.
p045.s6.b3: Suffrage on Jerusem is universal, but the value of a vote ranges from one up to one thousand according to one’s mota, or morontia wisdom. Citizens pass through three stages of examination.
p045.s6.b4: Every one hundred years of universe time each system chooses ten representatives for the constellation legislature. Both the council of one thousand electors who choose them and the representatives themselves must be graduates of the highest school of the Melchizedek College of Administration. The vote belongs to three orders of citizenship: the Material Sons and Daughters, the seraphim and their associates, and the ascending mortals.

p045.s6.b6: No ascending mortal leaves for the constellation until the Material Sons certify the achievement of mota personality: an individuality in which the completed mortal existence and the budding morontia career are blended under the spiritual overcontrol of the Thought Adjuster. Wisdom, insight, and social maturity must grow together before one moves on.
p045.s7.b0: Paper 45 may look like a description of administrative structure, but beneath it runs a theme of restoration and education. A loyal ruler holds the system steady after the wound of rebellion; a rehabilitated Adam and Eve sit on the council; and the way is open for missed experience to be made up and lost children to be reunited with their parents. The universe does not abandon those who have failed; it teaches them again.

p045.s7.b2: Paper 46 describes the physical features of the same system capital, Jerusem: the structure of that world and the settings of its life.
p046.lead: The place closest to the heaven our traditions have pictured: the light and air of Jerusem, its broadcasts and circles, and the erased history that awaits the end of rebellion.

p046.foot.text: Presented by an Archangel of Nebadon

p046.s0.h: Introduction — A First Look at Heaven
p046.s0.b0: Paper 45 introduced the administration of Satania; Paper 46 portrays its capital, Jerusem, as a world. Jerusem is an average capital of a local system and, apart from irregularities caused by the Lucifer rebellion and Michael’s bestowal, typical of such spheres. Satania has passed through stormy experiences, but it is now administered most efficiently, and the results of disharmony are being slowly but surely eradicated.
p046.s0.b2: This sentence sets the perspective for reading the paper. The “heaven” people have vaguely imagined is in fact closer to the first station of the ascent than to its end. And even that first station far exceeds anything we can picture.
p046.s1.h: I. Physical Aspects of Jerusem — Light Without Day or Night
p046.s1.b0: Jerusem is divided into one thousand latitudinal sectors and ten thousand longitudinal zones, with seven major capitals and seventy minor administrative centers. The Master Physical Controllers circulate the energy charges of space through zone channels, and the heat produced by resistance in those channels keeps the temperature even.

p046.s1.b2: The light does not come from one place; it sifts out of the whole sky and carries much less heat than sunlight. Such headquarters worlds therefore do not shine in space; Jerusem would not be visible even if it were near Urantia. For seventy-five per cent of the day the light is even; then it recedes to about the brightness of a full moon, and the whole world enjoys a quiet hour of rest and rehabilitation.
p046.s1.b3: The author compares the gases of Jerusem’s upper ionosphere, which reflect the light, to the upper-air gases on Urantia connected with the northern lights. On Urantia the same kind of gas shield turns broadcast waves back toward the earth, keeping them near the surface. Even when describing an unfamiliar world, he gives us clues from phenomena we already know.
p046.s2.h: II. Physical Features of Jerusem — A World Without a Struggle for Existence
p046.s2.b0: Jerusem has neither earthquakes nor rainfall, no raging rivers or expansive oceans. Instead there are thousands upon thousands of small lakes joined by canals, and moisture condenses each day during the light recession. The air is like Urantia’s with a third gas added for morontia life. Material beings travel on energy currents at two to five hundred miles an hour, and transport birds fly at about one hundred.
p046.s2.b1: Most striking is the order of life. Because there is no organic evolution on Jerusem, there are no conflicting forms of life, no struggle for existence, and no survival of the fittest. In their place is a creative adaptation that foreshadows the beauty and harmony of the central universe.
p046.s2.b3: Yet the author reminds us that Jerusem is far more material than spiritual. It has no smoking chimneys, but it does have an intricate material economy and an extensive laboratory sector. From Mount Seraph, almost fifteen thousand feet high, a seraphic transport departs every three seconds. That the first stop is not so different from earthly life shows that the passage after death is a continuation, not an abrupt break.
p046.s3.h: III. The Jerusem Broadcasts — The Joy of Hearing Universe News
p046.s3.b0: Superuniverse and Paradise-Havona broadcasts are received in liaison with Salvington by a technique involving the sea of glass. In addition, three groups of receiving stations take in broadcasts from the local worlds, the constellation headquarters, and the local universe capital. The amphitheater around the receiving station seats over five billion material and morontia beings.
p046.s3.b2: When Paradise messages arrive, the whole population gathers around the sea of glass, and the Uversa friends add reflectivity so that everything heard becomes visible. Listening to the broadcasts is the only activity that does not slow down during the light recession. Only the messages of Michael sometimes go directly to their destinations over the archangels’ circuit.
p046.s4.h: IV–V. Residential and Administrative Areas; The Jerusem Circles — Where Three Kinds of Existence Live Together
p046.s4.b0: Jerusem oversees 619 inhabited spheres, 56 transitional-culture worlds, and the capital itself, and its layout consists of four kinds of areas. This arrangement is common to all system capitals in Nebadon, though in another universe it might be entirely different, according to the plan of the Creator Son.

p046.s4.b5: Until nineteen hundred years ago the center of the circles of the Sons was an open space. Now the Michael memorial stands there; at its dedication Michael was present in person, and all Jerusem heard the story of his bestowal on Urantia, the least of Satania. That the story of the smallest world occupies the center of the capital suggests that love, not size, determines what is central.
p046.s4.b7: Around the circles of the angels runs the exhibit panorama, five thousand standard miles in circumference, showing the progress of the worlds of Satania. In the circles of the ascending mortals stand 619 planetary memorials, which mortals from each world revise from time to time; many changes are being made in the Urantia structures even now. At the center of the circles of the finaliters is a vacant temple sealed with the insignia of Michael.
p046.s4.b8: The recorders of the angelic groups live apart in the Jerusem temple of records, where all records are kept in triplicate, in material, morontia, and spirit form. At the center of the circles of the Universe Aids stands the headquarters of Galantia, a wholly transparent monolithic crystal fifty miles in diameter, and since the activities of the Evening Stars moved here, the whole world has become spiritually fragrant.
p046.s4.b10: The activities of such a world are work, progress, and play—service, study, and relaxation—along with social intercourse, group entertainment, and divine worship. The observation that there is great educational value in mingling with very different groups of personalities applies directly to our own community life today.
p046.s5.h: VI–VII. The Executive-Administrative Squares; The Rectangles — The Spornagia
p046.s5.b0: The executive-administrative departments occupy one thousand squares grouped in ten divisions: physical maintenance; arbitration and ethics; planetary affairs; constellation and universe affairs; education; science; morontia affairs; pure spirit activities; the ministry to ascenders; and grand universe philosophy. These structures are transparent, so even student visitors can watch all system activities. Administration with nothing to hide is the picture of heavenly government.
p046.s5.b1: The spornagia of the rectangles are the landscape gardeners of the headquarters worlds. They have no Adjusters, no survival souls, and no personality, yet they live forty to fifty thousand standard years, and when their bodies wear out they take up residence in new ones. They are the only creatures in all Nebadon who experience reincarnation. They respond only to the first five adjutant mind-spirits and combine the traits of a faithful horse and an affectionate dog, with an intelligence exceeding that of the highest chimpanzee.
p046.s5.b2: Some, the author adds, believe that in a future universe age these faithful spornagia will rise above the animal level to intellectual growth and even spiritual achievement. That such a possibility may be open even to beings without soul or personality invites us to reconsider how we treat all life in creation.
p046.s6.h: VIII. The Jerusem Triangles — Erased History and the Promise of Restoration
p046.s6.b0: The routine affairs of Jerusem are handled in one hundred triangles, which are surrounded by a panoramic depiction of the history of the system headquarters. In that history, however, there is an erasure of over two standard miles. It will be restored when Satania is readmitted into the constellation family.

p046.s6.b2: This erased history shows that the wound left by rebellion has not yet healed, but it is also a promise that the gap will be filled. The rulers of the universe are merciful and patient, yet they do not leave deliberately nourished evil in place forever.
p046.s6.b3: Even if Urantia were restored to the system circuits, difficulties would remain as long as all Satania rests under a Norlatiadek quarantine. Satania cannot return to the full fellowship of the constellation so long as it harbors archrebels.
p046.s7.b0: Paper 46 turns a vague notion of heaven into the concrete picture of a first station. There we find creative harmony instead of a struggle for existence, transparency instead of hidden administration, and continuity with earthly life instead of a break. And the story of Urantia, the least of worlds, stands at the center of the capital. The wound of rebellion remains, but the erased history will surely be restored.

p046.s7.b2: Paper 47 turns to the seven mansion worlds that circle Jerusem’s first transition world, describing in detail the path mortals will walk when they first awaken after death.
p047.lead: From awakening in the resurrection halls, through seven worlds that make up the deficiencies of mortal nature, to citizenship on Jerusem: a guide to the first journey after death.

p047.foot.text: Sponsored by a Brilliant Evening Star

p047.s0.h: Introduction — The Many Mansions in the Father’s Universe
p047.s0.b0: Paper 47 turns the “many mansions” Jesus spoke of into concrete places. All fifty-six worlds around the system capital, Jerusem, are devoted to the transitional culture of ascending mortals, but the seven satellites of the first transition world are known in particular as the **mansion worlds**. This is where people first awaken, learn, and grow after death.
p047.s0.b2: These worlds do not run by themselves. Many orders of beings share in their administration, and when a system is settled in light and life, the mansion worlds one by one stop serving as training stations and are taken over by finaliters. The mansion worlds, in other words, are not an eternal destination but a school for the needs of an age.

p047.s1.h: I. The Finaliters’ World — Parenthood No One Can Escape
p047.s1.b0: The first transition world is the headquarters of the finaliter corps assigned to Satania. The temple of the finaliters is not visible even to early morontia vision, but with the help of the energy transformers students can now and then actually perceive their activities. The nearness of brethren who have attained Paradise is a quiet encouragement throughout the ascent.
p047.s1.b1: The most striking feature of this section is the **parental commission**. On the first mansion world every survivor must pass the requirements of the parental commission from his or her native planet. The present Urantia commission consists of twelve couples who have reared three or more children to the pubescent age. Those who do not satisfy it qualify further by serving in the homes of the Material Sons on Jerusem or in the probationary nursery.
p047.s1.b3: The idea that child culture is largely the task of mothers is called an unfortunate and mistaken notion. Raising children is an essential part of completing personality, and if it is missed on earth, it must be made up in the heavens. This section reminds us that the time spent with children at home today is part of eternal growth.
p047.s2.h: II. The Probationary Nursery — Children Who Left Early
p047.s2.b0: Children who die before acquiring individual status on the universe records are not forgotten. If either parent survives, cherubim deputized by the guardian of destiny take custody of the child’s potential identity and deliver it to the probationary nursery on the finaliter world. The child awakens at the exact time of the parent’s arrival on the first mansion world, in the exact physical status it had at death.

p047.s2.b2: These children, too, have freedom of choice. Those who reject the ascent simply become as though they had not been, without adjudication; those who choose the Paradise path go at once to the mansion worlds, and many arrive in time to join their parents in the Havona ascent. Because they were deprived of evolutionary experience, they do not enter the Corps of the Finality but become the permanent ascendant citizenship of Paradise.
p047.s3.h: III. The First Mansion World — Starting Again Where We Left Off
p047.s3.b0: At the very center of the first mansion world stands the **resurrection hall**, the temple of personality assembly. Resurrection is the reuniting of what two custodians have kept. When the morontia soul entrusted to the seraphic destiny guardian is reunited with the spirit-mind held by the Adjuster, the sleeping survivor awakens.

p047.s3.b3: Death lets no one skip growth. Between death and resurrection a person gains nothing but the fact of survival. That is why almost the entire work of the first world is **deficiency ministry**, the correction and cure of defects left by life in the flesh. After awakening, each person has ten days of liberty to explore the new home and to look up loved ones who arrived earlier.
p047.s3.b4: On this world ascenders meet their Morontia Companions, one assigned to each company of a thousand. Offspring of the Mother Spirit, they are excursion guides and leisure associates who accompany ascenders even on visits to Jerusem. It is moving that, for those taking their first steps in a strange world, friends are provided first of all.
p047.s4.h: IV. The Second Mansion World — Healing for Community and Intellect
p047.s4.b0: On the second world, working groups and social organizations take shape, and the sea of glass appears for the first time. A new morontia body is acquired at each advance, but now the Adjuster does not leave during the transit sleep, and personality continues unbroken. The main task here is the removal of intellectual conflict and the cure of mental disharmony.
p047.s4.b2: The account of memory is also a comfort. Purely animal associations perish with the brain, but everything with survival value is counterparted by the Adjuster and retained. No worth-while experience we have had on earth is ever thrown away.
p047.s4.b3: Even with morontia bodies, ascenders continue to eat, drink, and rest through all seven worlds, though morontia food is fully utilized and leaves no waste. The first world is still very material, but with each sphere one becomes less material, more intellectual, and slightly more spiritual. Spiritual progress is greatest on the last three worlds.
p047.s5.h: V–VI. The Third and Fourth Mansion Worlds — From Remedy to Progress, From I to We
p047.s5.b0: The third world is the headquarters of the Mansion World Teachers, advanced and glorified cherubim. The training of the first two worlds is mostly remedial, supplementing the life in the flesh; here truly progressive morontia culture begins. Morontia mota is co-ordinated with human philosophy, and ascenders are introduced for the first time to the intelligent comprehension of cosmic meanings.
p047.s5.b1: On the fourth world ascenders are first introduced to the true social life of morontia creatures. Social activity based neither on personal aggrandizement nor on self-seeking conquest is an entirely new experience for evolutionary creatures. Those used to competition on earth learn here an order built on mutual appreciation and service.
p047.s6.h: VII. The Fifth Mansion World — The Birth of Cosmic Consciousness
p047.s6.b0: The move to the fifth world is a tremendous step forward. Experience here is a real foretaste of Jerusem life, and having mastered the local universe language, ascenders perfect the tongue of Uversa and become bilingual. Here, too, they meet the first instructors who prepare them for the constellation study worlds.
p047.s6.b2: This sentence shows the mark of growth. Study, service, and worship that began as duties come at some point to well up from within. This is how **a real morontia character** begins to bud, and we can rehearse the same change here on earth.
p047.s7.h: VIII. The Sixth Mansion World — Adjuster Fusion
p047.s7.b0: The sixth world usually witnesses the brilliant event of perfect fusion between the human mind and the divine Adjuster. When fusion is confirmed, messengers speak before the survivor’s associates, and the new being, introduced by a new name, is granted forty days of spiritual retirement in which to choose a route to Havona.
p047.s7.b2: Even so, these beings are far from being true spirits, still a little lower than the angels. Yet as the worlds are ascended, the shadow of mortal nature grows less, and those who have come up through great tribulation become very kind and understanding, sympathetic and tolerant. Hardship is being turned into loveliness.
p047.s8.h: IX. The Seventh Mansion World — The Last Traces Washed Away
p047.s8.b0: The seventh world is the crowning achievement of the immediate postmortal career. Differences between those from retarded worlds and those from advanced ones are virtually obliterated here, and the remnants of unfortunate heredity and unwholesome environment are purged. On the seventh transition world ascenders begin a new and more spiritual worship of the unseen Father.
p047.s8.b1: Until now ascenders have moved from world to world as individuals, but they leave for Jerusem together, in classes. That one may choose to tarry on the seventh world so that a slower member of one’s group can catch up shows that the ascent is not a race to get ahead alone.

p047.s9.h: X. Jerusem Citizenship — After the Last Awakening
p047.s9.b0: The arrival of a class of graduates is the signal for all Jerusem to assemble in welcome. Mortals who pass through the whole mansion world career experience the adjustment sleep and resurrection awakening seven times, but the last awakening chamber was left behind on the seventh world. From now on, changes of form never again interrupt consciousness or memory.
p047.s9.b2: The end of the paper gathers the whole picture. Death is a technique of escape; the seven mansion worlds are the introduction to the morontia career; and the morontia career is the transition life between material existence and spirit attainment. Death is not an end but the door to the next grade of the school.
p047.s10.b0: Paper 47 portrays the afterlife not as a vague paradise but as a school with stages. That school resumes our lessons where we left off, lets us make up what we missed on earth, and leads us at last to social and spiritual maturity. What we learn in this world, then, is never wasted. However far we get here, that is how far ahead we start there.

p048.s0.h: Introduction — There Is No Magic in Death
p048.s0.b0: Paper 48 opens with a firm declaration. The Gods do not transform a creature of animal origin into a perfected spirit in a single step. The belief that death instantly turns the mortal mind into a perfected spirit is no more than a pleasing fable. Between the mortal estate and spirit status there always lies the **morontia transition**.
p048.s0.b2: This may sound cold, but it is in fact a word of hope. Because growth comes in stages, even our small efforts now are not lost; they become the starting point of the next stage. Paper 47 showed the order of the seven mansion worlds; this paper shows the materials, the people, and the ways of learning that support that path.
p048.s1.b0: The morontia realms are the local universe liaison spheres between the material and spiritual levels. These architectural worlds have just double the number of elements of the evolved planets: one hundred physical elements plus exactly one hundred forms of an energy organization called **morontia material**. In the system the life is very much like that of our present world, becoming more spiritual on the constellation and Salvington spheres.

p048.s1.b2: As the body changes, so does our relation to the spirit. In the days of the flesh the divine spirit indwells us almost as a thing apart, but in the morontia life it becomes a real part of the personality. The number 570 shows how carefully the ascent is divided into steps.
p048.s1.b3: Morontia materials are not symbols; they are real. The paper explains that Paul spoke of a “⟦Q 48:1.7⟧better and more enduring substance⟦/Q⟧” in heaven and of “⟦Q 48:1.7⟧the city which has foundations⟦/Q⟧” because he knew of these worlds. The life to come is not a land of faint shadows but a world of substance more solid than our own.
p048.s2.h: II. Morontia Power Supervisors — Makers of the Transition Environment
p048.s2.b0: The Morontia Power Supervisors are offspring of the Mother Spirit. Rather than ministering directly to mortals, they make the transition environment itself possible. The first of them are created when the first mortal survivor arrives on a mansion world, and they come in groups of one thousand, divided into seven classes.

It is real growth, not a fixed timetable, that opens the next stage.

p048.s3.b0: Morontia Companions are offspring of the Mother Spirit, and there are over seventy billion of them in Nebadon. There are two types, aggressive and retiring, and after the midway creatures and the morontia cherubim they are the nearest of kin to human beings. Satania lost thousands of them in the Lucifer rebellion, and its quota has only recently been made up.

p048.s3.b3: Technically, the companions are not essential to survival; you could reach Salvington without them. Yet the universe has provided these friends. It shows the character of the ascension plan: it gives not only what is needed but cares for our joy as well.
p048.s4.h: IV. The Reversion Directors — Humor, the Divine Antidote
p048.s4.b0: The ascendant life is about equally divided between work and play. The reversion directors are a volunteer corps drawn from beings ranging from Havona natives to morontia progressors, who help their fellows achieve thought change and mind rest. Spirit humor never accentuates the misfortunes of the weak, and it is never blasphemous of divinity.

p048.s4.b3: Humor is a safety valve that keeps pressure from building up, and it softens the unexpected impact of fact and truth. Play and relaxation are always echoes of a backward glance; without memories of past experience there would be no basis for laughter. Knowing how to laugh, then, is no obstacle to the ascent but something close to essential equipment.
p048.s5.h: V. The Mansion World Teachers — No Short Cuts
p048.s5.b0: The Mansion World Teachers are deserted but glorified cherubim and sanobim. When a mortal leaves the flesh, the seraphim no longer needs these lieutenants; they pass through the embrace of the Mother Spirit and become teachers. Having already shared experience with their pupils on their native worlds, they are uniquely sympathetic teachers.

p048.s5.b3: One purpose of the morontia career is to eradicate such animal vestigial traits as procrastination, equivocation, insincerity, problem avoidance, unfairness, and ease seeking. What we could have learned on earth but did not must be learned there in the end. This passage invites us to ask what we are putting off today.

p048.s6.b0: The morontia life actually begins on earth, at the conception of the soul, when the Adjuster indwells a mind of moral status. But we become conscious of the ministry of the transition seraphim only on the mansion worlds. They are the sixth order of seraphim and serve in seven divisions.

p048.s6.b3: The seraphic evangels urge earthly teachers, too, to proclaim the love of God that casts out all fear, and the paper presents a song of trust said to have been whispered in the night to a shepherd boy. It also explains that the “heaven” of most prophets was the first mansion world, and Paul’s “third heaven” the third mansion world. The sevenfold mansion world experience is only the first of the “⟦Q 48:6.23⟧heaven of heavens,⟦/Q⟧” followed by Jerusem, Edentia, Salvington, Uversa, Havona, and Paradise.
p048.s6.b4: The mind planners never manipulate students or take advantage of their ignorance; they respect the newborn morontia will. The truth they teach even on earth is simple yet profound: if your own mind does not serve you well, you can exchange it for the mind of Jesus. The recorder-teachers teach us to seek truth as well as fact.
p048.s6.b6: The teaching of the ministering reserves is the most practical counsel in the paper. The work is important; the self is not. What wears us out is not the weight of the work but the energy spent guarding the dignity of the ego. They also point out that our most disappointing disappointments have sometimes become our greatest blessings.
p048.s7.h: VII. Morontia Mota — Philosophy Seen with Two Eyes
p048.s7.b0: Mota is more than a superior philosophy; it is to philosophy as two eyes are to one, giving depth to meanings and values. On the first mansion world the simpler concepts of mota are taught in one column, with analogous statements of human philosophy in the other. The author records twenty-eight statements of human philosophy used in such a lesson.
p048.s7.b3: These statements are brief maxims, yet they are where mansion world study begins. Cleverness is no substitute for character; impatience is a spirit poison; knowledge is possessed only by sharing. They are sentences well suited to taking up one at a time, each day, for reflection.
p048.s8.h: VIII. The Morontia Progressors — Why Such a Painstaking School?
p048.s8.b0: From graduation from the mansion worlds until spirit status in the superuniverse, ascenders are called morontia progressors. The purpose of this elaborate training is not endless ease. If the Gods meant only to take us on an eternal joy excursion, they would not turn the whole universe into one vast training school. Beyond the horizon of the present age lies a goal of **transcendent service**.
p048.s8.b1: The road from mortal man to Paradise finaliter means actually living every phase of perfected finite creature existence. So, the paper says, in any future creation there will be no order of beings whose lives are wholly different from those the finaliters have already lived.
p048.s9.b0: Paper 48 paints the everyday life of the hereafter in remarkable detail. The body changes 570 times, languages are learned by study, and teachers, friends, and directors of humor are always near. All of it points to one thing: growth comes not by magic but by experience, and that experience has already begun here and now.

p049.s0.h: Introduction — The Cradle of the Mortal Races
p049.s0.b0: Paper 49 turns our gaze back from the mansion worlds to the starting point. Every inhabited world is evolutionary in origin and nature, the cradle of the mortal races of time and space. And the principle that each stage of the ascent is a training school for the next holds just as true on an evolutionary planet as it does in the Melchizedek school at the universe headquarters.
p049.s0.b2: A local system is limited to about one thousand evolutionary worlds, but Satania is an unfinished system with only 619 inhabited worlds. Urantia is number 606 among them—the 606th world on which human beings appeared. The oldest, world number one, is Anova, one of forty-four satellites circling an enormous dark planet, and it has already reached an advanced stage of civilization.
p049.s0.b3: Not every planet is fit for life. Small planets with a high rate of axial revolution are wholly unsuited, and planets that are too large produce oppressive gravity. Yet the moons that circle such giant planets are often close to Urantia in size and almost ideal for habitation. Anova is just such a satellite world.

p049.s1.h: I. The Planetary Life — Evolution, Not Accident
p049.s1.b0: Cosmic evolution is not always predictable, but it is never a matter of chance. The Life Carriers are the living catalyzers who set off the first reactions of material life, and they design the plant and animal life of each world differently. Those differences, however, are not whims; they are decisions made in keeping with the evolutionary pattern of Nebadon.
p049.s1.b2: Evolution is the rule of human development, but the process varies greatly from world to world. Life may begin in one center, or in three as it did on Urantia, and on atmospheric worlds it usually has a marine origin. The Life Carriers have great latitude at this initial stage, yet that latitude operates within law and order.
p049.s1.b4: Vegetable life always comes before animal life, and every animal type is developed from the basic patterns of the plant kingdom. Nor is the rate of reproduction what drives evolution: mice multiply far faster than elephants, yet elephants evolve more rapidly. The paper adds that superior strains of living protoplasm should be guarded with care, and that most inhabited worlds value them far more highly than Urantia does.
p049.s2.h: II. Planetary Physical Types — Seven Body Designs
p049.s2.b0: The Life Carriers keep a standard pattern for each system but modify it to fit the physical conditions of each planet. The result is seven distinct physical types and thousands upon thousands of minor variants. The greatest single factor in these differences is the atmosphere.

p049.s2.b2: The account of the elemental types stirs the imagination. On some worlds the first civilization of a primitive race takes shape in the air and treetops; on others, amid the shallow waters of sheltered tropic basins and in the marine gardens of the dawn races. Even on Urantia there was a long age when primitive man lived mostly in the treetops. Yet these beings are neither human fishes nor human birds; they are distinctly mortal. Height, too, varies with a planet’s gravity, and the average in Nebadon is a trifle under seven feet.
p049.s2.b3: What is striking is that none of these differences touches the intellectual or spiritual life. Neither the variations among electric types nor those of the unnamed types affect mind or spirit. The body’s design is a garment fitted to the environment, not the essence of who a person is.
p049.s3.h: III. Worlds of the Nonbreathers — An Extreme Adjustment
p049.s3.b0: Mortals live even on planets with little or no air. This type accounts for less than seven per cent of the inhabited worlds of Orvonton and less than three per cent in Nebadon, and there are only nine such worlds in Satania. Because Satania still abounds in meteoric bodies, worlds without a protective atmosphere suffer incessant bombardment, so the advanced nonbreathing races build electrical installations that consume or shunt the meteors.
p049.s3.b1: They neither eat food nor drink water; their metabolism and nervous reactions are radically different; and even in survival they differ, being candidates for Spirit fusion. Still, they live out their lives with the same relative trials and joys as other mortals. And the paper tells us that such a race inhabits a sphere in close proximity to Urantia.
p049.s4.h: IV. Evolutionary Will Creatures — Different, Yet Alike
p049.s4.b0: All mortals of will dignity are erect, two-footed animals. There are six basic evolutionary races; the average endowment of special physical senses is twelve; and the span of life ranges from twenty-five years on primitive worlds to nearly five hundred on the older spheres. Sex equality prevails on all advanced worlds.
p049.s4.b1: Family life is fairly uniform on every type of planet, and children are usually born one at a time. Agriculture is universal on all atmospheric worlds, and mortals in their early days struggle against microscopic foes. Human beings are gregarious, both tribal and racial, and these tendencies can be modified only by advancing civilization and gradual spiritualization.
p049.s4.b3: However different the bodies, mind is the bestowal of the Infinite Spirit and functions in much the same way everywhere, and the careers that follow death are very much alike. Yet mind itself is mortal. Survival depends on the birth and growth of the immortal soul through the ministry of the Adjuster; at the very least, a person must not have turned against the Adjuster’s work.
p049.s5.h: V. The Planetary Series of Mortals — Seven Viewpoints
p049.s5.b0: Mortals can be classified from seven viewpoints: adjustment to planetary environment, brain type, spirit reception, planetary epochs, creature kinship, Adjuster fusion, and the techniques of terrestrial escape. In several of these Urantia holds an exceptional place, because it is an **experimental planet**, a world where the Life Carriers try to produce beneficial variations in the standard life designs.

p049.s5.b4: Universe administration is not only vertical, through systems and constellations. There are also horizontal groupings that link worlds and creatures of a similar nature, inspected periodically by corps led by long-experienced finaliters. The experimental worlds are linked as well, and in Satania they are inspected by a corps whose chief is the veteran finaliter Tabamantia. p049.s6.h: VI. Terrestrial Escape — Many Roads Beyond Death
p049.s6.b0: Mortals of every type alike receive the ministry of Thought Adjusters and guardian angels, and all alike go on to the morontia worlds. How they leave the planet, though, depends on their spiritual development. Primitive mortals of the early ages are too immature for fusion with their Adjusters, so the guardian seraphim awaken them in conjunction with an individualized portion of the spirit of the Third Source and Center. The cessation of nonsalvable personalities, too, takes place not on the planet but on the mansion worlds. On worlds nearing light and life, by contrast, those who fuse with their Adjusters are spared death, submitted to Son seizure, and carried directly to the resurrection halls of the higher morontia spheres.

p049.s7.b0: The universe of Paper 49 is astonishingly diverse. Ways of breathing, heights, brain structures, and planetary histories all differ. p050.s0.h: Introduction — The First Ruler of an Evolving World
p050.s0.b0: Paper 49 showed the variety of the inhabited worlds; Paper 50 introduces the one who first comes to govern such a world. The Planetary Princes belong to the order of Lanonandek Sons, but their service is so specialized that they are treated as a distinct group. Secondary Lanonandeks certified by the Melchizedeks serve in the constellation reserves and in various assignments before being commissioned as Planetary Princes.
p050.s0.b1: The signal for sending one comes from the Life Carriers. When they ask for an administrative head for a planet on which they have established life and developed intelligent evolutionary beings, the System Sovereign assigns a ruler. Every planet inhabited by evolutionary mortals has a ruler of this order. The author of the paper is himself a Son of this order, and when he writes of a colleague’s betrayal, his pain shows through.
p050.s0.b2: Understanding the Planetary Prince unlocks many chapters of Urantia’s history. Because this world’s prince, Caligastia, joined the rebellion, the sequence of civilization that would have been natural on a normal world was twisted here. So the paper first sketches an average evolutionary world, letting us compare it with Urantia as it is. Only by knowing the normal picture can we see our own world’s wounds clearly.
p050.s1.h: I. Mission of the Princes — The Nearest Son, the Loneliest Post
p050.s1.b0: The Planetary Prince is the last of the orders of personal Sons reaching out from Paradise to humankind. The Infinite Spirit draws near through the angels, and the Universal Father through the Mystery Monitors; but the Planetary Prince is the nearest approach, aside from incarnation, that the Eternal Son and his Sons make to us. On a newly inhabited world he alone represents complete divinity.

p050.s1.b3: But nearness brings risk. To sympathize with an evolutionary world, its ruler must be of a lower order, close to the human; yet the closer he is, the greater the danger that he will exalt his own mind above the will of the Supreme Rulers. Standing alone as representatives of divinity, these Sons are severely tested, and the fact that the Father is not personally present in the local universe is itself a test of faith and loyalty.
p050.s1.b5: This passage holds up a mirror to anyone in a position of leadership. The greater our authority and the farther we stand from those above us, the easier it is to lose the sense of proportion about our own importance. Even so, most princes pass the test and prepare their planets for the Material Sons and the Paradise Sons who follow.
p050.s2.h: II. Planetary Administration — A Fatherly Rule
p050.s2.b0: The Planetary Prince is under the jurisdiction of Gabriel, the chief executive of Michael, and directly subject to the mandates of the System Sovereign. He may at any time seek the counsel of the Melchizedeks or of the four and twenty counselors of the system—who in Satania are at present all natives of Urantia. The Melchizedeks, however, do not interfere unless they are asked.
p050.s2.b1: In their early years the evolutionary planets are ruled largely autocratically. The prince usually has a supreme council of twelve, and his staff, averaging about one thousand, may grow to a hundred thousand or more as the planet advances. Every planet provides tribunals of justice, and the judicial system of the local universe begins in the tribunals of the prince.
p050.s2.b3: Yet discretion has its limits. No arbitrary execution is ever carried out without the consent of the Constellation Father. The principle that the Most Highs rule in the kingdoms of men is honored down to the lowest level of planetary government.
p050.s2.b4: Roving commissions of conciliators supplement the planetary tribunals, and the controllers and transformers can help make celestial beings visible to mortals. The chief reason for bringing ascending mortals onto the prince’s staff is to make communication with the inhabitants easier. Good rule begins not with commands alone but with being understood.
p050.s3.h: III. The Prince’s Corporeal Staff — Ascenders Who Put On Bodies Again
p050.s3.b0: When a prince goes to a young world, he takes with him a group of volunteer ascenders from the system headquarters. They are the material link between the prince and the world races, and Caligastia had one hundred such helpers. They are citizens of the system capital who have not yet fused with their Adjusters; leaving their Adjusters at headquarters, they take on new physical bodies prepared by the Life Carriers.

p050.s3.b2: The staff seldom mate with the world races, but always mate among themselves. Their children join the mortal races only in emergencies and by the prince’s direction, and in that case the grandchildren stand in status with the superior races of their day. The uplifting of a planet’s races is thus planned with care, not left to chance.
p050.s3.b3: These volunteers fall a whole dispensation behind their Jerusem classmates, but in exchange they gain a rare chapter in the ascending career. It is striking that the choice to turn back and help others, rather than press on ahead, becomes in the end a treasure of unique experience.
p050.s4.h: IV. The Planetary Headquarters and Schools — and Caligastia’s Betrayal
p050.s4.b0: The corporeal staff early organize the planetary schools of training and culture, where the cream of the evolutionary races are taught and sent back to teach their own peoples. In the headquarters settlement every home was given abundant land, and students and teachers alike were farmers and gardeners. Their time was divided roughly equally among five pursuits.

p050.s4.b2: The prince himself is invisible to mortals, so believing what his staff report is a test of faith. Still, the schools are so well suited to each planet’s needs that the races vie keenly for admission, and the children trained there return home to found new centers of culture.
p050.s4.b3: On Urantia, too, the plan was going well. But when Caligastia joined the Lucifer rebellion, he deliberately perverted and poisoned the teaching of every planetary school, and the schools were swiftly and completely wrecked. Even so, many descendants of the staff remained loyal and kept spiritual truth from vanishing altogether.
p050.s5.h: V. Progressive Civilization — Seven Epochs of Development
p050.s5.b0: A loyal prince stays permanently with the planet of his first assignment. Paradise Sons come and go, but the prince’s work is to foster planetary civilization steadily. Civilization takes different shapes on different worlds, yet every evolutionary world passes through seven epochs in well-defined directions.

rows: 1. The nutrition epoch

2. The security age

3. The material-comfort era
Luxury vies with necessity — often tyranny, intolerance, gluttony, and drunkenness
4. The quest for knowledge and wisdom
A culture that learns by experience; education is the watchword
5. The epoch of philosophy and brotherhood
An ethical society, living by the golden rule
6. The age of spiritual striving

7. The era of light and life

p050.s5.b3: This chart can be read against the growth of a single person as well as a society. Once bread and safety are reasonably secure, it is easy to chase comfort, but the next stages are knowledge and wisdom, brotherhood, and spiritual striving. When the era of light and life opens, the prince is elevated to Planetary Sovereign.
p050.s5.b4: The description of the third epoch is especially sharp. An age in which luxury vies with necessity is too often marked by tyranny and intolerance, gluttony and drunkenness, and the pleasure-seeking weaklings are finally subdued by the stronger, truth-loving elements. From the fourth epoch education becomes the watchword, and in the fifth people become truly moral beings, able to establish brotherhood.
p050.s6.h: VI–VII. Planetary Culture; The Rewards of Isolation
p050.s6.b0: Compared with the loyal worlds, Urantia appears most confused and retarded, intellectually and spiritually. All of Satania has rested under a spiritual ban for two hundred thousand years, and this world suffered the double tragedy of a rebellious Planetary Prince and a defaulting Material Son. Yet even an ideal world is no flowery bed of ease; the early life of the mortal races always involves struggle.
p050.s6.b2: The author explains that Urantia’s isolation prevents him from describing in detail the life of our Satania neighbors. Even the bestowal of Christ Michael did not immediately set aside the temporal consequences of the early blunders in this world’s administration. He also warns that culture depends on the quality of mind: inferior minds will spurn the highest culture even when it is handed to them ready-made.
p050.s6.b4: The final section holds a remarkable reversal. Isolated worlds are deprived of the help of superhuman personalities, but in exchange they gain a unique opportunity to develop faith and a confidence in cosmic reliability that does not depend on sight. Ascenders from such worlds are very early entrusted with special assignments that require unquestioned faith.
p050.s6.b6: The agondonter grouping persists even in the Corps of the Mortal Finality, and Tabamantia, the finaliter who inspects the experimental worlds, is himself an agondonter. A handicapped beginning does not end in eternal loss; it becomes the source of a distinctive quality.
p050.s7.b0: Through the story of a planet’s first ruler, Paper 50 shows us leadership, loyalty, and the growth of civilization. At the same time it offers comfort to those of us who live on a world where that rule broke down. Faith that believes without seeing is a special asset that an isolated world can cultivate, and such effort always leads to its reward.

p050.s7.b2: Paper 51 turns to the biologic uplifters who follow the Planetary Prince: the Planetary Adams. Seeing how the prince’s rule and the Adamic mission fit together makes the weight of Urantia’s double tragedy all the clearer.
p051.lead: Adam and Eve, the material gift of the Creator Son to the evolutionary worlds: their nature and mission, the Edenic regime, and what Urantia missed.

p051.foot.text: Presented by a Secondary Lanonandek Son of the Reserve Corps

p051.s0.h: Introduction — The Second Sons to Arrive
p051.s0.b0: When primitive man reaches the limit of natural evolutionary development during the dispensation of a Planetary Prince, that attainment signals the System Sovereign to send the second order of sonship. These are the **biologic uplifters**, the Material Son and Daughter, usually known on a planet as Adam and Eve. The original Material Son of Satania was named Adam, and all who go out to the worlds of the system carry his name.
p051.s0.b2: They remain on their planet, together with the Planetary Prince, throughout its evolutionary course. On a world with a loyal prince the venture holds little hazard, but on an apostate planet, with no spiritual ruler and cut off from communication, the mission is fraught with grave danger. Urantia was just such a place. Even so, the paper says plainly that Adam’s mission was not in vain and that the councils on high do not reckon it a total loss.
p051.s1.h: I. Origin and Nature of the Material Sons of God — A Link Between Spirit and Matter
p051.s1.b0: The Material Sons and Daughters are the offspring of the Creator Son; the Universe Mother Spirit does not take part in producing them. The Creator Son makes only one pair for each system, attuned to the life pattern of that system—otherwise the reproductive potential of the Adams could not function with the mortals of those worlds. The Adam and Eve who came to Urantia descended from the original Satania pair.
p051.s1.b1: They stand eight to ten feet tall, and their bodies glow with a violet light. Material blood flows in them, yet they are surcharged with divine energy, and they sustain their immortality by a dual nutrition: they eat materialized energy and also take in cosmic energies directly. Adam and Eve are equal yet different, male and female, complementing each other, and they are designed to serve almost always in pairs.
p051.s1.b3: This immortality, however, is conditional. If they fail in their mission or rebel, they are cut off from the source of light and life, become practically material beings, and finally meet material death. In Satania thirteen Planetary Adams and 681,204 Material Sons in subordinate posts have been lost through rebellion and default, most of them at the time of the Lucifer rebellion.
p051.s1.b4: Material Sons do not have Thought Adjusters, but through planetary service they acquire the experiential capacity for Adjuster indwelling and the Paradise ascent. Above all, unlike other created Sons, they can be seen by mortals and can mingle with them. Children born to them on an evolutionary planet are not immune to natural death, and their longevity decreases with each generation.
p051.s2.h: II. Transit of the Planetary Adams — A Road with No Return
p051.s2.b0: When a world reaches the height of physical evolution, the System Sovereign convenes the corps of Material Sons and chooses, from among the volunteers, an Adam and Eve of the senior corps. Because they are semimaterial, seraphim cannot carry them as they are; they are dematerialized over about three days and then enseraphimed for the journey. On arrival the Life Carriers direct their rematerialization, which takes ten to twenty-eight days, and they remain unconscious the whole time.
p051.s2.b1: What stands out is that this is a one-way road. There is a technique for sending them from Jerusem to an evolutionary world, but no equivalent method for bringing them back. The exception is a planet doomed by physical catastrophe, when the technique of dematerialization is installed for all the salvable survivors, who are carried to a new world. Adam and Eve leave home having chosen to share the destiny of the world they go to serve.
p051.s3.h: III. The Adamic Missions — The Garden and the Violet Race
p051.s3.b0: On arrival, the Material Son and Daughter build their garden home on a site chosen by the Planetary Prince. These gardens are called Eden in honor of Edentia, the constellation capital, and they are usually placed in a secluded, near-tropic region. The pair’s chief business is to multiply and uplift the children of time, but they do not intermingle at once; for many generations they remain apart and build up a strong race of their own order, the **violet race**.
p051.s3.b2: Urantia’s Adam and Eve were at a great disadvantage from the start. Caligastia mounted crafty opposition, and despite the warnings of the Melchizedek receivers, the Edenic pair were outmaneuvered and violated the covenant of their trusteeship. Yet the attempt to draw them into the Lucifer rebellion failed.
p051.s3.b3: The paper reveals that the voice that rebuked them in the Garden was not God but the seraphim Solonia, chief of the planetary helpers. It notes that because tradition ascribes everything supernatural to the Lord God, Urantians have often been confused about the nature of the Universal Father. This is worth remembering when we read the biblical story.
p051.s3.b4: The secondary midway creatures belong to the Adamic missions. On Urantia most of the primary midwayers rebelled with Caligastia and have been interned since Pentecost; on that day the loyal primary and secondary midwayers voluntarily united, and they have served as one unit in world affairs ever since.

p051.s4.h: IV. The Six Evolutionary Races — The Gift of Diversity
p051.s4.b0: On the inhabited worlds the red man is usually the first to reach human levels, and the other colored races appear soon afterward. The Life Carriers give the full bestowal of living energies to the first race, and each later race shows variation at the expense of that original endowment. The paper explains that the first, third, and fifth races are the more highly endowed.

p051.s4.b2: Yet this differentiation is not simply a loss. The appearance of several races provides desirable variations in mortal types and allows an expression of diverse human potentials that could not be had otherwise. When this diversity is later upstepped by the Adamic race, it serves the progress of mankind as a whole. On normal worlds, primitive slavery is abolished soon after the arrival of the violet race.
p051.s4.b3: On Urantia this plan of amalgamation was not extensively carried out. The paper therefore says that we cannot understand the status of these peoples on an average inhabited planet by looking at the remnants of the early races on our world. The picture of a normal world is not a yardstick for judging our present reality but a reference map showing where things went astray.
p051.s5.h: V. Racial Amalgamation — Bestowal of the Adamic Blood
p051.s5.b0: The violet people usually do not begin to blend with the natives until they number over a million. On normal worlds the Planetary Adam and Eve themselves never mate with the evolutionary races; that work belongs to their offspring. The prince’s staff bring superior men and women to the Garden for voluntary mating with the Adamic children, and on most worlds being chosen is considered the highest honor.
p051.s5.b1: This plan reduces racial wars and sets the races competing to qualify for admission to the Garden. The violet race is monogamous, and every man or woman who unites with an Adamic son or daughter pledges to take no other mate and to teach their children single-matedness.
p051.s5.b3: On Urantia the plan miscarried, yet great progress has been made since Adam’s life plasm was given to our peoples. The paper says that we must now work out the problem of race improvement chiefly by human methods of adaptation and control rather than by the Adamic technique.
p051.s6.h: VI. The Edenic Regime — Two Centers of Culture and Seven Fathers
p051.s6.b0: On normal worlds the garden headquarters becomes the second center of world culture, setting the pace of civilization together with the city of the Planetary Prince. The two schools are not far apart and work in harmony, eventually merging into one. The author invites us to imagine what it would mean if somewhere in the Levant there were a world university of culture that had functioned without interruption for 37,000 years.

p051.s6.b3: The Material Son and Daughter are the last link between God and man. They are material, even sex creatures like us, yet they can see the invisible Planetary Prince and his staff and interpret him to mortals. As the centuries pass and their offspring blend with the races, they come to be accepted as the common ancestors of mankind.

p051.s7.h: VII. United Administration — A World Governed Together
p051.s7.b0: With the first Magisterial Son the fourth dispensation begins, and the planet prospers under the joint rule of the Planetary Prince, the Material Son, and the Magisterial Son. Meanwhile the educational and administrative work of the prince and of Adam is united, and when the Magisterial Son departs, Adam assumes the outward direction of the sphere. When the era of light and life arrives, the prince becomes Planetary Sovereign, and Adam and Eve serve as what might be called joint prime ministers.
p051.s7.b1: The roles are divided as well. The prince and his staff foster the spiritual and philosophic domains, Adam and Eve attend to the physical, scientific, and economic status of the realm, and both promote the arts, social relations, and intellectual achievement. Once the new capital is established, from fifty to one hundred subcapitals are organized.
p051.s8.b0: Paper 51 keeps us from seeing Adam and Eve only as ancestors who went wrong. They were a gift sent by the Creator Son, volunteers who took a road of no return to share the destiny of their world. Despite their failure, the lineage they left behind hastened human progress. Knowing what was lost should lead not to resentment but to recognizing the part that now falls to us.
